name: io.github.tonyyang0504/admob-mcp
description: Google AdMob (ads): me, list_accounts, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ADMOB_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console > Credentials) of a project with the AdMob API enabled.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ADMOB_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The OAuth client's secret, sent in the form body of the refresh_token grant.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_ADMOB_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from Google's consent flow (offline access) with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admob.readonly (or admob.report); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it.
